purpose: Define the minimum real evidence, fairness, budget, recommendation activation, and ranking readiness rules for StarBench Phase-2 without authorizing or executing a campaign.

candidate_identity.reason: Provider-specific latency, availability, billing, and rate-limit behavior are recommendation evidence.

evidence_units.task: One versioned Benchmark Task and Prompt identity.
evidence_units.run_observation: One admitted real provider execution for one candidate and one task.
evidence_units.task_evidence: The candidate-specific aggregate of accepted run observations for one task.
evidence_units.scenario_evidence_count: The number of distinct required tasks with valid Task Scores, not the number of repeated runs.

campaign_budget_contract.rule: A populated budget record is still a plan until a separate explicit campaign authorization exists.

candidate_comparison_requirement.max_tokens_difference_rule: Any difference must be declared before execution, justified by provider limits, and marked incomparable when truncation can change task success.

new_candidate_entry_requirement.ranking_entry_rule: The new provider/model candidate enters a Scenario comparison or ranking only after it independently satisfies every evidence and parity gate for that exact scope.

cost_evidence.unknown_cost_policy: Capability-only recommendation is allowed when all cost gates and cost preference weights are disabled; cheapest-model and cost-efficiency claims are forbidden.

recommendation_activation_requirement.activation_rule: At least one named Scenario must pass every evidence, safety, provenance, parity, and recommendation condition; real_raw_result_count > 0 alone never activates readiness.

ranking_readiness_requirement.unknown_dimension_policy: Exclude an unknown dimension and its claims explicitly; never treat UNKNOWN as zero or best.

abstain_rules.NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE: All in-scope candidates fail an explicit hard constraint or allow/deny rule.
abstain_rules.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: At least one in-scope candidate exists, but coverage, distinct tasks, successful runs, confidence, required metrics, or repetition thresholds are not met.
abstain_rules.ABSTAINED: Required data is unknown, evidence is incomparable or unbalanced, source classes are mixed, integrity is ambiguous, or policy explicitly requires abstention.
abstain_rules.RECOMMENDED: All hard, evidence, provenance, safety, compatibility, parity, and uniqueness conditions pass and a non-null winner with evidence references exists.

phase2_execution_order.name: Campaign authorization and immutable snapshot
phase2_execution_order.stop_condition: No explicit provider/model allowlist and hard request/cost budget.

phase2_execution_order.name: Instruction-following paired minimum Suite
phase2_execution_order.reason: Lowest evaluator complexity; validates paired fairness and can unlock only this Scenario first.

phase2_execution_order.name: Instruction-following activation review
phase2_execution_order.stop_condition: Any safety, provenance, parity, coverage, or stability gate fails.

phase2_execution_order.name: Coding paired minimum Suite
phase2_execution_order.reason: Adds executable correctness and constraint evidence only after the cheaper Scenario passes.

phase2_execution_order.name: Planning paired minimum Suite
phase2_execution_order.reason: Adds the remaining high-information Scenario after earlier stop gates pass.

phase2_execution_order.name: Recommendation and ranking readiness review
phase2_execution_order.stop_condition: Never fill missing evidence with fixtures or an additional unapproved request.
